### Template acceptance checks

- [ ] settings.mcs.yml exists and preserves the initialized identity, environment binding, language, and authoring mode.
- [ ] All five implemented compliance operations are represented by instructions, a manual skill, or a bound tool.
- [ ] Both synthetic knowledge files are loaded and clearly labeled as fictional pilot evidence.
- [ ] Record **not applicable to this disconnected workshop** for the production-only criterion: “Every production data source uses a dedicated and verified connection reference with least-privilege access.”
- [ ] The audit, certification, trade-surveillance, algorithm-go-live, and board-evidence prompts return the expected synthetic identifiers.
- [ ] Remediation output distinguishes prepared corrections from transmitted filings and requires authorized reviewer approval.
- [ ] Public value statements remain qualitative; exact figures are presented only as synthetic evidence.
- [ ] Publishing remains a separate, user-approved step after push and validation.

Source: [catalog acceptance contract](../../../solutions/catalog.json).
